xBRIEFInfo.description: gate(agents-md): invert agents-entry propagation contract to pointer-sufficient

plan.title: gate(agents-md): invert agents-entry propagation contract to pointer-sufficient

narratives.Description: The agents_entry_contract currently requires full-text rule mirrors in content/templates/agents-entry.md and AGENTS.md. This story changes that contract so a pointer to a skill, gate, or lazy doc is sufficient, which is the Wave 1 unblocker for epic #2369 relocation.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Edit packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts to replace full-text PROPAGATION_* marker requirements with pointer-sufficient checks for skill/gate/doc shapes. 2) Update content/templates/agents-entry.md (and refresh AGENTS.md managed section if required) so universal rules can be one-line + pointer. 3) Add regression fixtures proving full rule bodies are not required when pointers resolve. 4) Verify: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts. 5) CHANGELOG entry under Fixed/Changed for pointer-sufficient propagation.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want the agents-entry propagation contract to accept pointer-sufficient rule homes, so that Wave 2 can relocate rule bulk without the always-on file forcing full-text mirrors.
narratives.Origin: Enriched for swarm launch from GitHub issue #2371 under epic #2369

items.title: Change contract markers to pointer-sufficient semantics

narrative.Acceptance: Given a relocated rule with only a pointer in agents-entry/AGENTS.md, when the contract runs, then it passes for the correct pointer shape.
Given fixtures for pointer-to-skill, pointer-to-gate, and pointer-to-doc, when tests run, then each shape is validated and full-text is not required.
Given the updated contract, when the relevant vitest/content contract suite runs, then it exits 0.
